name: Uplink7 Automatic Translator for Google Translate
author: Uplink7

sections.description:
Uplink7 Automatic Translator for Google Translate is a lightweight and powerful solution to make your website global. It uses the official Google Translate engine to provide instant translations into over 100 languages.

Unlike other plugins, it focuses on performance and SEO. Features include:
* Lazy-Load Technology: The Google Translate script only loads when needed, keeping your site fast.
* Automatic Injection: Place the translator in the header, footer, or as a floating widget without touching code.
* SEO Optimized: Supports Hreflang tags to help search engines index your translated content (Premium).
* Privacy & Protection: Includes email protection to prevent bots from scraping your email addresses in translated versions.
* Full Customization: Adjust colors, borders, and font sizes to match your brand design.

External Services

This plugin relies on the third-party service Google Translate to provide the translation functionality.
* Service: Google Translate (Google LLC)
* Usage: It loads the Google Translate API script to enable the language switcher and content translation.
* Data sent: When a user interacts with the translator, technical data (such as the IP address and browser information) may be sent to Google to provide the service. No personal WordPress user data is transmitted.
* Links: Google Privacy Policy, Google Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Uplink7 Automatic Translator to configure your options.
  4. Use the Shortcode [u7at_translate] or the PHP function <?php echo u7at_get_widget_html(); ?> if you prefer manual placement.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. We use a lazy-load approach, meaning the external Google script is only called after the initial page load or upon user interaction.

Can I hide the Google branding?

Yes, the Premium version includes “Brand Protection” which hides the Google logo and “Powered by” text for a cleaner look.
